{{Top}}
[[File:Six_Virtues_Theed.png|thumb|right|250px|The Six Virtues in the frontcourt of the Theed Royal Palace.]]The '''Six Virtues''' were a set of statues that watched over the frontcourt of [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]], sculpted by [[Fasano Eckener]]<ref name="EXPVD">''[[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace: The Expanded Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> around [[532 BBY/Legends|532 BBY]]<ref name="EXPVD">''[[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace: The Expanded Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>. The statues depicted six winged warriors representing strength, honor, fidelity, steadfastness, wisdom, and charity<ref name="EXPVD">''[[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace: The Expanded Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>. The Six Virtues were carved from marble and each stood approximately 30.5 meters tall<ref name="ARTEP1">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace]]''</ref>.
